headline: Removing prevent_destroy from a data bucket to work around CI failures, rather than fixing the root cause

findings.evidence_ref: Removed lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } block from aws_s3_bucket.data in data_stores.tf
findings.explanation: The prevent_destroy lifecycle rule protected this bucket from accidental deletion. Removing it means a terraform destroy or resource removal will now succeed without warning, risking data loss on a bucket explicitly named 'data'. The PR description indicates this is a workaround for CI failures rather than an intentional operational change.
